facts.fact: The government portal reports that the Prime Minister directed the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications, with the Ministry of Health, to digitise hospital systems within two weeks through a first pilot phase at Soba teaching hospital and Gedaref hospital, applying an electronic system for managing medical records, with expansion to follow an evaluation of the pilot; the page is undated and the date is the document's published date, taken from a SUNA republication.
facts.system: electronic system for managing medical records (hospital systems digitisation)
